subject: Post-discovery: scheduling 30-min product intro and stakeholder windows
messages:
From: grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
To: samir.patel@helixtech.com, ana.gomez@helixtech.com
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, priyom.das@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-21T15:02:00-08:00
Subject: Post-discovery: scheduling 30-min product intro and stakeholder windows

Hi Samir / Ana —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap (so we’re aligned):
- Primary goal: evaluate Redwood Inference for a low-latency inference tier for HelixTech’s customer-facing search feature.
- Success criteria you mentioned: sub-100ms median latency on P50 for 512-token contexts, token-cost budget < $0.002/token, and SOC-2 evidence for initial pilot.
- Key stakeholders to include for the next call: Dev lead (Ana), Platform/infra (you indicated Samir), and a Security contact (if available).

Next step: 30-minute product intro (brief demo + ops/readiness Q&A). To make scheduling easy, proposed 3 windows — pick 1 or tell us preferred alternatives:
1) Tue Nov 24, 10:00–10:30 PT / 13:00–13:30 ET
2) Wed Nov 25, 15:00–15:30 PT / 18:00–18:30 ET
3) Thu Nov 26, 09:00–09:30 PT / 12:00–12:30 ET

Ben (cc’d) will cover technical architecture and can do a deeper follow-up if the team wants a hands-on infra session. Priyom (cc’d) will bring the mutual action plan and procurement checklist.

Attachment: discovery-notes-helixtech.pdf — short summary from today’s call and a suggested agenda.

If none of the windows work, drop 2–3 times that work and we’ll match the right tech owners.

Thanks,
Grace O
Grace O'Connor
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.ai

From: samir.patel@helixtech.com
To: grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
Cc: ana.gomez@helixtech.com
Date: 2026-11-22T09:12:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: scheduling 30-min product intro and stakeholder windows

Grace —

Appreciate the recap and the clear success criteria. Short answers: Ana and I are available to join, security will need to be looped but can attend if it's within business hours.

Preferred windows from our side:
- Wed Nov 25, 15:00–15:30 PT (works for our west coast folks)
- Thu Nov 26, 09:00–09:30 PT (backup)

Two quick asks:
1) Can you include a 5-minute slide or callout on fallback routing and cost controls (we're particularly interested in caching and burst policies)?
2) Please confirm who from your side will cover SOC-2 evidence and any standard security questionnaire items during the call or immediately after.

Thanks — we’ll confirm internal security availability and send a calendar hold once you confirm final slot.

Best,
Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Platform Engineering, HelixTech
samir.patel@helixtech.com
